name: Uncategorized — Level 3 — Messenger of the Winds

system.description:
The Assamites could not maintain their clan's cohesion across thousands of miles without this ritual, which sends a written communication to anyone in the world, so long as the sorcerer knows the recipient's name and possesses enough of her blood to write that name upon the message. It is limited to written communication; the sorcerers who use it most serve at Alamut with access to the clan's Heartblood.

The sorcerer need not write the message himself, but it must be inked on clean linen with a pen made from an eagle's feather, rolled, and tied with white silk cord. On the cord he writes the recipient's name in her own blood, then carries the message outside and casts it into the sky, where the wind bears it away. It appears in the recipient's possession at precisely noon of her next day of slumber. This ritual fails if the document is enchanted in any other way (though it may contain magical formulae or instructions). A failed casting sends the message to a random recipient connected to the intended target in some fashion.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
system.bloodCost: None (requires a sample of the recipient's blood)
